column2: Unless you suggest I frame it and admire the pattern.
No sir. I'll process it now.
Have this decoded. I would prefer to know what we have received before discussing it.
Certainly, sir. I'll attend to the message.
Don't stand up. Make yourself useful at the Obscura.
Yes sir.
I have received this in cipher. I need the readable copy.
I'll begin the decoding, sir.
Someone has spent considerable effort concealing these words. Recover them.
Yes sir. I'll process the message according to the orders.
I want the decoded text, not an imaginative account of what it might say.
Understood, sir. I'll keep to the actual result.
This has reached my desk in a form I cannot use.
You require it decoded, sir?
Correct. Let us avoid pretending I can make decisions from alphabet soup.
Yes sir. I'll attend to it.
Can your machine make sense of this?
I can process it for decoding, sir.
Then begin. I shall reserve judgment until we can read it.
Very good, sir.
Take this cipher. Apply the proper procedure before anyone acts on it.
Yes sir. I'll decode it and report the assessment.
I am expecting a readable message when you have finished.
I'll carry out the decoding and the required checks, sir.
That is what I meant. No shortcuts.
Understood, sir.
Here is some incoming traffic. Your compartment gets to it before mine can use it.
Yes sir. I'll examine it for decoding.
You have the equipment and I have the paper. Let us combine the two.
Certainly, sir. I'll begin processing the message.
I don't require a lesson on ciphers.
No sir.
I require this one decoded.
At once, sir.
This ought to tell us something useful. Establish what it actually says.
Yes sir. I'll decode the message before reporting the result.
I have had enough people peering at this over my shoulder.
I'll process it here, sir.
Good. At least one of us should use a machine instead of a confident expression.
Yes sir.
Decode this without improving on the sender's words.
Of course, sir. I will reproduce the actual result.
I trust you are prepared for a little work.
Yes sir.
Then take this cipher and tell me what the decoding produces.
I'll get started, sir.
The paper is mine to carry. The problem of reading it is yours.
Understood, sir. I'll attend to the decoding.
How much do you need to know about this before you start?
I need to examine the message and apply the current orders, sir.
Good. I was not planning to hold a briefing here.
Yes sir.
Read this through the Obscura, if you please. I have no talent for staring meaning into ciphers.
Certainly, sir. I'll process it carefully.
Keep your seat and your attention on this.
Yes sir.
Decoding. I want the result before I draw any conclusions.
Understood, sir.
I should like to know whether this traffic deserves the attention it has been getting.
I'll decode it and assess it under the standing orders, sir.
This is for your station. The next discussion can wait until we have plain text.
Yes sir. I'll examine the cipher.
Somebody suggested I might recognize a few words in this.
It will need proper decoding, sir.
Exactly. Which is why I have brought it to someone paid to do that.
I'll begin, sir.
Decipher this message. I will take responsibility for interpreting it.
Understood, sir. I'll confine my report to the processing and assessment.
Is the Obscura available?
Yes sir.
Good. I have coded traffic requiring its operator.
I'll process it now, sir.
I expect the text in there is less mysterious than its journey to my desk.
I'll see what the decoding produces, sir.
I need this put into readable form with the usual care.
Of course, sir.
Usual care means the full procedure, even with me waiting here.
Understood, sir.
I brought you a cipher, operator. Try not to look as though I have brought you a punishment.
No sir. I'm ready to begin the decoding.
Good. I prefer willing competence, but competence will suffice.
Yes sir.
Decoded and in order?
Yes sir. The message is decoded and accepted.
Good. Now there is something I can actually read.
The decoded copy is ready, sir.
You haven't helpfully filled in what you thought the sender meant?
No sir. The output is the decoded message.
Excellent. I prefer the sender's mistakes to an operator's improvements.
Understood, sir.
I see. That gives me rather more to consider.
The decoding is complete and the message is accepted, sir.
The considering is my part. You have done yours.
Yes sir.
Is this the cleared decoded copy?
Yes sir. Ready for you to examine.
A readable message. I shall count that as progress.
The processing is complete, sir.
You may count it as work done properly.
Thank you, sir.
The contents appear rather serious. What do you make of them?
Interpretation is for you, sir. I can confirm the message is decoded and accepted.
A properly limited answer.
Thank you, sir.
The source goes with the decoded sheet?
Yes sir. The papers are kept together.
You have made the cipher surrender its words.
Yes sir. The message is decoded and cleared.
Let us see whether the words are any more cooperative.
Of course, sir.
I take it everything required by the orders has been checked?
Yes sir. The decoded message has been accepted.
Very well. I shall take it.
Certainly, sir.
Good. I need not carry a mystery back to the wardroom.
The decoded copy is ready for you, sir.
You look as if you are waiting for me to ask about the result.
The decoding is successful, sir. The message is accepted.
There. That was all I needed.
Yes sir.
I can read the words. Are they cleared as well?
Yes sir. The message passes the required checks.
Good. Readable and reliable must not be confused.
Understood, sir.
Thank you. That is a much more useful page than the one I brought.
You're welcome, sir. The decoding is complete.
Any further business for me at this desk?
None with this task, sir. The decoded message is ready and accepted.
Then I shall get to the business it has created elsewhere.
Yes sir.
I hope you haven't been worrying about what I will do with it.
No sir. I have attended to the decoding.
Good. There are enough officers worrying about that already.
Understood, sir.
Finished according to the standing procedure?
Yes sir. Decoded and accepted.
For a moment I wondered whether that machine would give us anything readable.
The message has decoded successfully, sir.
I am pleased to find my doubts were unnecessary.
Thank you, sir.
The words are theirs, the responsibility for reading them is mine.
Yes sir. The decoded result is cleared.
A manageable arrangement. Carry on.
Very good, sir.
Is there anything preventing me from taking this for review?
No sir. The decoded message is accepted and ready.
I shall need to read this without a row of interested faces behind me.
The papers are ready for you, sir.
Naturally, that includes yours, operator.
Of course, sir.
This was worth bringing to your desk.
Glad to be of service, sir. The message is decoded and accepted.
Keep your attention on the next one as well.
I will, sir.
That answers what was said. The rest can wait until I have read it.
Yes sir. Decoding is complete.
Was there any need to depart from the procedure?
No sir. The message has been processed under the current orders.
Good. Results are more reassuring when they don't require exceptions.
Yes sir.
I now have a readable message and another decision to make.
The decoded message is accepted, sir.
You needn't look concerned. The decision will not be yours.
Understood, sir.
Very well. Give me the decoded paper with its source.
Certainly, sir. The result is cleared.
I expect you can be discreet about what passed through the machine.
Of course, sir. The contents will remain confidential.
Good. The decoding is successful; let us keep the delivery equally orderly.
Yes sir.
Everything in order. An encouraging start to reading it.
Yes sir. The decoding and checks are complete.
That will do. Keep your station ready.
I will, sir.
I came for plain text. You have provided it.
Yes sir. The message is decoded and accepted.
Do I have your assessment as well as the text?
Yes sir. Successfully decoded, accepted under the current requirements.
Excellent. You can return to your duties.
Thank you, sir.
FALSE ECHO, is it?
Yes sir. The message has been rejected.
I wanted a readable message, not another complication.
I understand, sir. I cannot clear this message under the standing requirements.
Very well. I prefer the complication to a false assurance.
Yes sir.
You are rejecting the traffic rather than asking me what to make of it?
Correct, sir. The result is FALSE ECHO.
Are you telling me there is nothing here worth following?
I am reporting that it is not accepted as valid traffic, sir.
Keep to that wording. I will decide what further attention it needs.
Understood, sir.
I had expected something quite different from this visit.
I'm afraid the message has failed the required checks, sir.
Expectations are a poor substitute for a result. I know.
Yes sir.
Not cleared. I shall have to reconsider what I was told.
The assessment is FALSE ECHO, sir.
Could you have obtained a more convenient answer from the machine?
I am required to report the actual result, sir.
Correct. Convenience was not a serious proposal.
Understood, sir.
This has acquired an unpleasant smell, and it is not the ventilation.
The message is rejected, sir.
That part is clear. I will attend to the unpleasant questions.
Yes sir.
I am not to treat this as an accepted message?
Correct, sir. It is a FALSE ECHO.
I suppose the contents are beside the point if it fails your assessment.
I cannot present it as cleared traffic, sir.
Then don't. I shall take the papers as they are.
Certainly, sir.
Has someone been telling me what I wanted to hear?
I cannot establish that, sir. I can confirm the rejection of this message.
Fair enough. Speculation would not improve my mood.
Understood, sir.
Rejected. I would rather hear that plainly than find it concealed in an explanation.
Yes sir. The result is FALSE ECHO.
Do you understand how awkward this makes things?
I understand the result is unwelcome, sir. It does not meet the requirements.
Yes. Awkwardness is not one of the requirements.
No sir.
You are sure this is an assessment and not an excuse for the machinery?
Yes sir. The rejection is the finding for this message.
Very well. I shall take the finding.
Certainly, sir.
So we have not obtained an accepted communication.
No sir. The message is rejected.
This looked promising when it arrived.
It has not passed the required checks, sir.
Promising things have a habit of reaching my desk before they are checked.
I understand, sir.
I will not have half the boat discussing a false message.
Of course, sir. I will keep the contents confidential.
The rejection as well, except where duty requires it.
Understood, sir.
FALSE ECHO. Dammit. Give me the result.
Certainly, sir. The message is rejected.
Should I be questioning the person who brought this to me?
I cannot assign responsibility from this assessment, sir.
I asked for your view. You have given a careful one.
Thank you, sir.
You are not recommending we act on this?
No sir. It is not accepted as valid traffic.
Good. I wanted that beyond any misunderstanding.
Understood, sir.
That settles whether I can treat it as cleared.
Yes sir. The assessment is FALSE ECHO.
I can see somebody trying to explain this away.
I can only report the rejection, sir.
That is sufficient. I don't require you to argue on their behalf.
Yes sir.
The fact that I needed this to be genuine makes no difference?
No difference to the assessment, sir.
Good. It would make a dreadful method of authentication.
Quite right, sir.
I shall take this as rejected traffic.
Yes sir. It has not been cleared.
I presume a second opinion would need to address the same requirements.
Yes sir. My assessment is that the message fails them.
Then I have no use for an easier opinion.
Understood, sir.
I was not planning on a FALSE ECHO today.
The message has been rejected, sir.
One seldom plans for things that require the most attention.
I understand, sir.
Do I have a decoded message I can accept?
Not a cleared one, sir. The result is FALSE ECHO.
I need this reported without suggesting you have uncovered an entire conspiracy.
Yes sir. The finding is limited to the rejected message.
Good. One problem at a time is quite sufficient.
Understood, sir.
I hope you are not as disappointed with your work as I am with this traffic.
I have followed the required procedure, sir.
Then keep following it. My dissatisfaction is with the message.
Thank you, sir.
Right. Rejected. I will consider what to do next.
Yes sir. The assessment is complete.
Attend to your station. This matter remains with me.
Understood, sir.
